prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one fantasy RPG inventory icon, square canvas, final display 48px. Subject: Iron Ring: practical charcoal grey iron finger band with a warm translucent honey amber stone set flush into the metal so it does not catch. Ring opening clearly visible in three-quarter view. Style: polished believable three-dimensional fantasy game item render, crisp bevels, restrained craftsmanship and realistic material response, not flat illustration. One object only centered in three-quarter product view, fills 80% of square with transparent padding. Soft studio light from upper left, strong readable silhouette and highlights at tiny size. Actual transparent background and true alpha. No floor, pedestal, cast background shadow, frame, text, watermark, extra objects, cartoon outline, or crude geometric placeholder. Pendants show short complete chain loop or bail only, no necklace extending outside frame.
